<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>flag, sign, miraculous event</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Num. XXV, 8; a. fr.—Y. Pes. V, 32
<sup>c</sup> bot. נסא הוה רב a great event (delivery from danger) had occurred; Y. Taan. III, end, 67
<sup>a</sup> ניסא. Ber. 54
<sup>a</sup> נ' דרבים a providential event which concerns the community, opp. נ' דיחיד. Meg. 3
<sup>b</sup> משום פרסומי נ' because it is a duty to proclaim the wonderful event (in the Book of Esther); Sabb. 23
<sup>b</sup> פרסומי נ' to proclaim the wonderful events (of the Maccabean days, by lighting the candles); a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. נִסִּין, נִסַּיָּא, נִסֵּי, נִי'</plural-form>. Targ. O. Ex. XVII, 15. Targ. Y. II Num. XXI, 14; a. fr.—Y. Ter. VIII, end, 46
<sup>c</sup>. Yoma 21
<sup>a</sup> נ' דגואי wonders which happened within the Temple; נ' דבראי outside of the Temple. Ib.
<sup>b</sup> נ' דקביעי permanent, regularly recurring wonders; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (= נִסָּיוֹן) 
<italic>trial.</italic></definition>
<notes>—
<italic>Pl.</italic> as ab. Targ. Y. II Ex. XV, 25.—Y. Maas. Sh. V, end, 55
<sup>c</sup> (oneirocritical play on נִיסַן) וניסין לית את חמי and thou shalt experience no trials; (Lam. R. to I, 1 רבתי נִסְיוֹנִין (חד מתלמ'); Ber. 56
<sup>b</sup> ולא אתית לידי נסיון).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N00917">
<head-word>נְסַב</head-word>
<head-word>נְסֵיב</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (corresp. to h. נָשָׂא a. נָטַל) 
<italic>to lift up; to take; to carry</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Gen. II, 21; a. fr.—נ' ויהב (= h. נשא ונתן) 
<italic>to deal</italic>. Targ. Zech. V, 6, sq.—נ' (איתתא) 
<italic>to take to wife, marry</italic>. Targ. Gen. IV, 19; a. fr.—נ' אפין (= h. נשא פנים) 
<italic>to be partial, favor</italic>. Targ. O. Gen. XXXII, 21. Targ. Y. Ex. XXIII, 3.—Part. pass. נְסִיב; f. נְסִיבָא, נְסִיבְתָּא; 
<plural-form>pl. נְסִיבִין; נְסִיבָן</plural-form>. Targ. O. Gen. II, 23. Targ. Y. Num. V, 22 נסיבתא wedded.—נ' אפין 
<italic>respected</italic>. Targ. Is. III, 3 (not נְסֵב); a. fr.—Y. B. Mets. II, 8
<sup>c</sup> bot. וחוא נָסֵיב כולא וכ' and he takes everything (entrusted to him) and runs away. Gen. R. s. 84, beg. דיִסַּב מאה וכ' that he should receive one hundred lashes; Yalk. Job 904; Yalk. Gen. 140 דיהיב (corr. acc.). Lam. R. to I, 1 סַב מובלא וכ' take that load &c. Ib. סב לי טימיתהון וכ' take their price at my hands and carry them &c. Y. Kidd. IV, 66
<sup>a</sup> נחות דרג וסב איתתא; Yeb. 63
<sup>a</sup> נְסַיב איתתא וכ', v. דְּרַג. Macc. 11
<sup>a</sup>; Gen. R. s. 80, v. גְּזַר; a. v. fr.—Zeb. 11
<sup>b</sup> היא אַגְּרָרָהּ נַסְבָהּ the redactor took this up (inserted it) by the way, v. גְּרָרָא II.—Cant. R. to II, 16 והוה נ' נפש and he took courage, felt better; ib. ואיתנסיב נפש read: והוית נסיב נפש and I felt better.—Y. Sabb. I, 3
<sup>a</sup> bot. נ' לידוי washed his hands (v. נָטַל). Y. Ber. VIII, 12
<sup>a</sup> bot. נַסְבוּן ידיכון (not נסבין) wash your hands; ib. סב בריך wash thy hands and say grace.—[Y. Maasr. IV, 51
<sup>b</sup> bot. והוון סבין מיניה, perh. to be read: והוון נסבין, they took from him.]</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַנְסֵיב, אַסֵּיב, </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, אֲסֵיב 
<italic>to cause to take</italic>, esp. 
<italic>to give in marriage to, to allow to marry</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Zech. III, 5. Targ. Y. Gen. XXXVI, 3 דאֲסִיבָהּ (not … בא); a. e.—Yeb. 121
<sup>a</sup> ואַנְסְבָהּ רב … לדביתהו (not ואנסבו) and R. D. allowed his wife to marry again; ib. ואנסבוה (corr. acc.). Ib. 120
<sup>a</sup> top לאַנְסוּבֵי לצרה וכ' (Rashi: לאִינְּס', 
<italic>Ithpe.</italic>) to permit her rival to marry before her. Lev. R. s. 34 ואַסְּבוּן יתיה איתתא וכ' and they made him marry another wife; Yalk. Is. 352 אסביתיה, read: אַסַּב יתיה; a. fr.—[Sabb. 123
<sup>a</sup> אַסּוּבֵי ינוקא 
<italic>to handle</italic>, treat the infant; v., however, אֲסַב.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נַסֵּב</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> same. B. Mets. 105
<sup>a</sup> קא מְנַסְּבַת וכ' thou causest my land to bear a bad reputation. Yeb. l. c. מְנַסְּבִינָן לה לצרה we allow the rival to marry; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְנַסֵּיב, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְנְסִיב, אִינְּסִּיב</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be taken; to be taken away; to be married</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Num. XXXV, 17. Targ. Y. Gen. II, 23. Targ. Jud. XVII, 2; a. fr.—Snh. 51
<sup>a</sup> משום דאִינְּסִיבָא להו להני because she is married to one of those. Yeb. 120
<sup>a</sup> (repeatedly) אינסיב (read אינסיבא). Ib. 43
<sup>b</sup> אִינְּסוּבֵי הוא דלא וכ' to marry she is not allowed, but to be betrothed &c.; a. fr.—Cant. R. to II, 16 איתנסיב, v. supra.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="N00921">
<head-word>נְסוֹרֶת</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (נָסַר) 
<italic>chips, saw-dust</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. IV, 1 (49
<sup>a</sup>) נ' של חרשין וכ' (Talm. ed. נְסוֹרוֹת 
<italic>pl.</italic>) (fine) saw-dust of the carpenters; Y. ib. 6
<sup>d</sup> bot. אנן תנינן נ' … נעורת וכ' we read 
<italic>n’soreth</italic>, the teachers of the house of Rabbi read 
<italic>n’ʿoreth</italic>, which shows that both mean the same. B. Kam. X, 10 (119
<sup>a</sup>) אף הנ' של בעה"ב Y. ed. (Mish. ed. הנִסָּרוֹת, some Bab. ed. הנִסָּרִים; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 200; Ar. הנסורות) even the saw-dust belongs to the employer.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N00923">
<head-word>(נָשַׂח) נָסַח</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>

<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. נסע)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to remove</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sot. 42
<sup>b</sup>; Yoma 75
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to יַשְׁחֶנָה, Prov. XII, 25) יִשְׂחֶנָּה מדעתו (Ms. M. 2 יַסִּיחֶנָּה, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 50) let him banish it from his mind; Yalk. Prov. 950; Snh. 100
<sup>b</sup> יַשִּׂיחֶנָּה; v. סוּחַ.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִסִּיחַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (with דעת) 
<italic>to divert the mind, to discard</italic>.</definition>
<notes>
<pgbrk id="pg916" />Sabb. 82
<sup>a</sup> יַסִּיחַ דעתו, expl. יסיח דעתו מדברים אחרים he must discard from his mind everything else. Y. Ber. VI, end, 10
<sup>d</sup> ה' דעתו (ed. Krot. הִסִּיעַ) if he has abandoned the thought (of drinking more wine); a. e.—Snh. l. c.; Yoma l. c., v. supra.—V. הֶסֵּיחַ.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="N00924">
<head-word>נְסַח</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to remove, take out</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Jud. XIV, 9 (h. text רדה).—Part. pass. נְסִיחַ. Ib.—Cant. R. to V, 14 אימיה נָסְחָא וכ' his mother took the bread out of the oven, and he ate; Pesik. B’shall., p. 90
<sup>b</sup>, sq. נשא (corr. acc.).—[</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to lift, weigh</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—Denom. מְסָחָא, מִסְחֲתָא.]</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נַסַּח</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to remove, sweep out; to exile</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lam. R. to I, 13 (expl. וירדנה, ib., with ref. to Jud. l. c.) נַסְּחָהּ (not נסחא) he removed (exiled) her.—Part. pass. מְנַסַּח. Targ. Prov. XXIX, 21 (h. text מנון!).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְנְסַח</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be pulled out</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Esth. VII, 9 (fr. Ezra VI, 11).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַסַּח</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> as preced. 
<italic>Hif.</italic> Zeb. 20
<sup>b</sup> אַסּוּחֵי מַסַּח דעתיה he discards (the service) from his mind; לא מַסַּח he does not.</definition>
<notes> Pes. 103
<sup>b</sup> אַסְּחִיתוּ דעתייכו you have abandoned the thought (of drinking). Gitt. 53
<sup>b</sup> א' דעתיה he ceased to have his mind on it (as sacred matter that must be guarded); a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="N00925">
<head-word>נסי</head-word>
<head-word>נָסָא</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to lift up, take, carry</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="N01284">נָשָׂא</xref>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N00926">
<head-word>נסי</head-word>
<head-word>נָסָה</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. preced.) 
<italic>to lift up</italic>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִסָּה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> same; 2) (denom. of </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<definition>נֵס) 
<italic>to put up a sign; to ask for a test</italic> (cmp. Is. VII, 11, sq.); 
<italic>to try, test</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 55, beg. (interpret. נִסָּה, Gen. XXII, 1) בשביל לנַסּוֹתָן … לגדלן וכ' in order to lift them up (as a standard) for the world, to raise them &c., v. נֵס. Ib. (ref. to Gen. l. c.) R. J. says גדלו כנס וכ' he raised him &c.; R. A. says, נ' אותן בוודאי he really tried him, v. וַדַּאי. Ib. אין הקב"ה מְנַסֶּה וכ' the Lord does not test the wicked, but only the righteous; ib. s. 32; s. 34. Mekh. B’shall., Vayassa, s. 1 (ref. to Ex. XV, 25) גדולה(ל) שם נשא לו there he raised him (Moses) to greatness; … שם נסה המקום את ישראל there God tested Israel. Ib. Yithro, Baḥod., s. 9 לבעבור נַסּוֹת אתכם בשביל לגדל אתכם (Ex. XX, 28) ‘to lift you up’, to raise you. Arakh. 15
<sup>a</sup> עשר נסיונות נִיסּוּ וכ' ten times did our ancestors try the Lord; Ab. V, 4; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְנַסֶּה, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְנַסֶּה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be tried</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. 3. Yalk. Ps. 777 הראשונים מִתְנַסִּים ביד הקב"ה … אבל האחרונים נִתְנַסּוּ וכ' the ancients were tried by the Lord …, but the latter generations were tried by the nations; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="N00927">
<head-word>נְסֵי</head-word>
<head-word>(נְשָׂא) נְסָא</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to lift up</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Deut. XXVIII, 56 נְסִיאַת ed. Berl. (oth. ed. נַסִּי', Pa.); Y. נַסְיַית (h. text נִסְּתָה). Targ. Ps. IV, 7 נְשָׂא (h. text נְסָה).—[Pesik. B’shall., p. 91
<sup>a</sup>, v. נְסַח.]</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to take, receive, carry</italic> (v. 
<xref rid="N00917">נְסַב</xref>).</definition>
<notes> Lam. R. to II, 2 לא נַסְיָין להון they (the areas described) could not receive (would have no room for) them; Y. Taan. IV, 69
<sup>b</sup> לא נַסְיָיהּ. Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 54
<sup>d</sup> נַסְתּוֹן בר קפר Bar Ḳ. took them. Lev. R. s. 6 נַסְתֵּיה לקניא וכ' he took the cane and knocked it down. Ib. s. 34, end נסאתיה וחמאי ליה וכ', read: נסא יתיה ואחמי וכ' he took him along and showed to him &c.; (Yalk. Is. 355 נסביה ואחמתיה וכ').—Pesik. R. s. 22 נשא ואפקדיה וכ' he took (his money) and put it in trust with him. Ib. נַסְתָּהּ ויהבה ליה she took it (the deposited money) and gave it to him; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נֵסֵּי</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to find out by sign, to divine</italic>.</definition>
<notes>. Targ. O. Gen. XXX, 27.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to try, test; to attempt</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Deut. XXVIII, 56, v. supra.—Targ. Esth. V, 14 למְנֵסְיָא צליבא to test the (strength of) the gallows. Targ. Ex. XVI, 4; a. fr.—Snh. 107
<sup>a</sup> מְנַסִּינָא לך I will try thee. Ib. אמר מינסנא לך (corr. acc.). Ab. Zar. 15
<sup>a</sup> ניסייה ניהלי, read: נִינַסְּיָיהּ let us try the animal for me; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַנְסֵי, הַנְסֵי</binyan-form>
<senses>

<senses>
<sense>

<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to make wine forbidden</italic> (יֵין נֶסֶךְ) 
<italic>by the manipulation of a gentile suspected of dedicating it to idolatrous purposes</italic>.</definition>

<sup>a</sup>; Sabb. 41
<sup>a</sup> אין פנאי לנַסֵּךְ they do not take the time to manipulate the wine. Ab. Zar. 56
<sup>b</sup> (in Chald. dict.) והא קא מנסך בידיה but might he not dedicate it to idolatry by putting his hand into it?; והא קא מנסך ברגל might he not do it with his foot (while treading the wine)? Gitt. V, 4 המנסך he who does damage to his neighbor by touching his wine for idolatrous purposes (v. interpret. ib. 52
<sup>b</sup>). Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 44
<sup>a</sup> bot. מנסך כל הבור he causes all the wine in the pit to be forbidden; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<sup>a</sup> כמים הנִיסָּסִין like the water which is poured on the altar, opp. הנשפכין which is poured out at the foot of the altar.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<italic>to be made forbidden</italic> (
<italic>as dedicated to idolatry</italic>).</definition>

<entry id="N00986">
<head-word>נָעַל</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to tie</italic> (the door), 
<italic>to lock up, close</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. VI, 1 נ' בפניה כראוי if he locked it in (secured the flock) properly. Tosef. B. Bath. II, 11, a. e. נ' וגדר וכ' if he fastened (something on the property), fenced in or tore down, it is possession (חֲזָקָה). Sabb. XIII, 6 ונ' אחד בפניו and one blocked it (by placing himself in the entrance). Ib. 7 לנוֹעֵל את ביתו וכ' it is like one locking up (sitting at the entrance of) his house to guard it. Mekh. Mishp. s. 18 שלא לִנְעוֹל בפני וכ' in order not to close the door to future proselytes (not to discourage them on account of advanced age). Snh. 32
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. כדי שלא תִנְעוֹל וכ', v. דֶּלֶת.—Y. Naz. VIII, 57
<sup>a</sup> bot., v. וַעַד. Tosef. Sot. V, 9 [read:] שנעל דלת וכ' who locked his wife up (to prevent her from going astray); Y. ib. I, 17
<sup>a</sup> bot.; Gitt. 90
<sup>a</sup>; Y. Kidd. IV, 66
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—Cant. R. to VII, 2 (play on בנעלים, ib.) אתם נוֹעֲלִים לפני … ואני נועל וכ' you lock up (interrupt business) for my sake on Passover …, and I lock up (the rain) for your sake, v. נְעִילָה. Ib. מה היה … שהיו נועלין בעד כל הצרות how great wa is the beauty of thy steps (pilgrimage to the Temple) which locked up (protected against) all troubles.—Part. pass. נְעוּל; f. נְעוּלָה; 
<plural-form>pl. נְעוּלִים, נְעוּלִין; נְעוּלוֹת</plural-form>. Midr. Till. to Ps. IV שערי תפלה … נ' וכ' the gates of prayer are sometimes open, sometimes closed, but the gates of tears are never closed; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to tie a sandal, to put shoes on</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Sabb. IV (V), 8 לא יִנְעוֹל אדם וכ' one must not put on a nail-studded sandal &c. Y. M. Kat. III, 83
<sup>c</sup> הורי … לנעול בו ביום R. … allowed (the people mourning for R. Yassa) to wear shoes on the same day. Tosef. Kidd. I, 5 נ' לו סנדלו וכ' if the slave tied his sandals for him (the new master) or untied them, it is possession (v. supra); B. Bath. 53
<sup>b</sup> (Ms. M. הִנְעִיל); a. fr.—Part. pass. as ab., 
<italic>shod</italic>. Yalk. Josh. 7 וכי במנעלים אתה נ' וכ' dost thou wear shoes and observest not mourning?</notes></sense></senses>

<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִנְעִיל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to put shoes on a person</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. l. c.; Kidd. 22
<sup>b</sup> הלבישו הִנְעִילֹו וכ' if the slave helped him put on his clothes or his shoes or lifted him up (helped him into a conveyance), it is possession.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִנְעַל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be closed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 32
<sup>b</sup> מיום … נִנְעֲלוּ שערי וכ' since the day the Temple was destroyed, the gates of prayer have been closed. Ib. שערי דמעה לא ננעלו; Midr. Till. to Ps. IV נִנְעָלִים, v. supra. B. Mets. 59
<sup>a</sup> כל השערים נִנְעָלִים חוץ וכ' all gates (of prayer) are (at times) closed, except the gates for the cry of oppression. Ib. הפרגוד ננעל, v. פַּרְגּוֹד. Erub. 6
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. אילמלא דלתותיה נִנְעָלוֹת if its gates were not shut by night; a. fr.—Sabb. 67

<entry id="N01007">
<head-word>נָעַר</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="P00343"> cmp. עור</xref>,
<xref rid="A00083"> ערר)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to shake, stir.</italic></definition>
<notes> Makhsh. I, 4 הנוֹעֵר אגודה וכ' he who shakes (the rain off) a bundle of vegetables. Ib. V, 7. Pesik. R. s. 26 לאיוב נָעַרְתִּי מן האשפה וכ' I shook Job (making him rise) from the dunghill, and concerning thee (Israel) it is written (Is. LII, 2), shake thyself &c.; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִיעֵר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to shake</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. Shek., p. 17
<sup>a</sup> נַעֲרָהּ קפלה shake it (the garment), fold it; Lev. R. s. 2. B. Mets. II, 8 מצא כסות מְנַעֲרָהּ וכ' if one found a garment (and holds it in charge waiting for the owner to claim it), he must shake it once in thirty days. Sabb. 147
<sup>a</sup> top; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to stir</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. VIII, 3 נ' את הקדרה if he stirred (the meat in) the pot. Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39
<sup>d</sup> top שמא נ' הגוי בקדרה the gentile might have stirred the pot; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to empty; to cause evacuation.</italic></definition>
<notes> Toh. II, 1 מְנָעֶרֶת את הקדרה she may empty (or 
<italic>stir</italic>) the dish. Kel. XXVIII, 2 לנָעֵר בו וכ' used for (lifting and) emptying the pot. Tosef. ib. B. Mets. II, 10 שהחנוני מְנָעֵר וכ' which the shop-keeper uses when pouring out &c. (or through which he pours for straining), v. יַתִּיךְ; a. e.—נ' את הצאן 
<italic>to use means by which to expedite the discharge of excrements of the flock on the spot to be manured</italic> (v. דּוּר I, 
<italic>Pi.</italic>). Tosef. Shebi. II, 20; M. Kat. 12
<sup>a</sup>; Y. Shebi. III, 34
<sup>c</sup> bot. Ib. השוכר … לנַעֲרָהּ he who hires a flock (for manuring) is forbidden to use means &c.; expl. ib. מוליכה ממקום וכ' by driving it from place to place.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְנוֹעָר; f. מְנוֹעֶרֶת; 
<plural-form>pl. מְנוֹעָרִים, מְנוֹעָרִין: מְנוֹעָרוֹת</plural-form>
<italic>empty, vacant</italic>. Y. Ber. IV, 7
<sup>b</sup> bot. (play on שִׁנְ֗עָ֗ר̇) שחם מנ' מן המצות וכ' they (the Babylonians) are vacant of (cannot perform) certain religious observances &c.; Koh. R. to XII, 7; Gen. R. s. 37 שהיא מנ' וכ' she (Babylonia) is deprived &c. Ḥag. 14
<sup>a</sup> (play on נערים, Is. III, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>4)</number>
<definition />
<notes> אלו בני אדם שמנ' וכ' that means persons empty of good deeds, opp. ממולא; Yalk. Is. 261.—[B. Bath. 74
<sup>b</sup> ור"י נוער some ed., v. 
<xref rid="P00342">עוּר I</xref>.—Ḥull. 51
<sup>b</sup> ניערה, v. infra.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִנְעַר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be stirred up; to bestir one’s self</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 74
<sup>b</sup> וני' ר''א and R. El. was stirred up (awoke). Sot. 5
<sup>a</sup> אין עפרו נ' his dust will not be stirred up (for resurrection). Ex. R. s. 1 (play on חלאה ונערה, I Chr. IV, 5) חלתה ונִנְעֲרָה מחליה וכ' she (Miriam) was sick, but she bestirred herself (arose) from her sickness, and the Lord restored her to youth. Y. Ber. III, 6
<sup>d</sup> top (play on מנעריו, Gen. VIII, 21) משעה שהוא נ' ויוצא וכ' from the moment the embryo bestirs itself to come out into the world; Gen. R. s. 34; Yalk. ib. 61. Ḥull. 51
<sup>b</sup> ננערה לעמוד וכ' Rashi (ed. נִיעֲרָה) if the animal made an effort to get up, although it did not succeed; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (of flax) 
<italic>to be hatcheled</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Sabb. II, beg. 4
<sup>c</sup> (expl. חוסן, ib. II, 1) פשתן שלא ננערה flax which has not yet been hatcheled.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be emptied, poured out</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ber. l. c. (play on שנער) ששם נִנְעֲרוּ וכ' for into that valley the dead of the generation of the flood were dumped; Gen. R. s. 37; Koh. R. l. c.—Snh. 92
<sup>a</sup> קשתו נִינְעֶרֶת his bow will be empty (his sexual vitality broken).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִנְעִיר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to stir up, to keep awake</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Erub. 53
<sup>b</sup> (play on נערה &c., v. אַהֲרוֹנִית) והִנְעִירָתוֹ and she kept him awake.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְנַעֵר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be emptied</italic>; trnsf. 
<italic>to be displaced</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Zeb. 116
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Cant. IV, 16) תִּתְנַעֵר אומה … ותבא וכ' (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) removed be the (Roman) nation whose sacrifices are slaughtered northward (Lev. I, 11, which is entitled only to burnt-offerings), and let the nation enter &c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<sup>b</sup> המְנַפֵּחַ בכלי וכ'. Makhsh. I, 6 הנופח בעדשים וכ' he who breathes at lentils to ascertain their quality. Tosef. Sabb. XV (XVI), 2 נופח בחוטמו וכ' you blow into its nostrils and put the teat into its mouth; Sabb. 128

<sup>b</sup> top אם לִנְצוֹחַ אם להִינָּצֵחַ whether to conquer or to be conquered. Pes. 119
<sup>a</sup> (play on לַמְנַצֵּחַ) זמרו למי שנוֹצְחִין אותו ושמח sing to him who rejoices when they conquer him (prevail over him to change his evil decrees); Midr. Till. to Ps. IV. Pesik. R. s. 40 נָצַחְתִּי לדור וכ' I conquered the generation of the flood and was the loser by it, because I destroyed &c. Ib. נְצָחַנִי משה וכ' Moses conquered me …, and I gained all those masses; a. fr.—Part. pass. נָצוּחַ. Ib. בשעה שאני נוצח … ובשעה שאני נ' וכ' when I prevail, I lose, but when I am prevailed over, I gain; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>

<italic>Pa</italic>.); Pes. l. c.—B. Mets. 59
<sup>b</sup> נִצְּחוּנִי בני (or נְצָחוּנִי) my children have won over me. Ib. תלמידי חכמים שמנצחים וכ' scholars who defeat one another in discussion. Snh. 91
<sup>a</sup> אם יְנַּצְּחוּנִי … נַצַּחְתֶּם if they defeat me, say to them, you have defeated an ignoramus among us; ואם אני אֲנַצֵּחַ … תורת משה נִצְּחַתְכֶם and if I defeat them, say to them, the law of Moses has defeated you; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְנוּצָּח.
